summary.text: Paul Schibbelhute is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Schibbelhute is running against incumbent Democrats Susan Elberger, Heather Raymond and Dale Swanson for the district's three seats.
